descriptions.description: Neotype (Irvine in Spencer & al. in Taxon, in press): Herb. Linn. No. 1274.102 (LINN).
Note: The specific epithet was spelled " gigantinus " in the protologue, subsequently corrected by Linnaeus in Syst. Nat. ed. 12 (1767).
